body: This Lithuanian file now has an Italian string ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:"), so Lithuanian users will see Italian text. It looks like the line was copied from messages_it. It needs a Lithuanian translation, for example "Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:".

Same problem as the account theme: loginTotpStep1 in the Lithuanian bundle has been replaced with Italian text ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:"), so Lithuanian users will see Italian on the OTP setup page.
This zh_CN (Simplified Chinese) file now has a Traditional Chinese string (手機 / 應用程式 / 安裝), which looks like it came from zh_TW. It should be Simplified, e.g. "在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：".

The account UI renders these messages with i18next, which substitutes `{{0}}` placeholders; the rest of this file and all the community translations of this key still use `{{0}}`. Changing to `{0}` plus a Java MessageFormat `{2,choice,...}` means i18next won't substitute anything, and the user will see the literal `{0}`/`{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` text. The only reason for the change seems to be passing the new verifier; the fix should be an exemption in the verifier rather than switching to a syntax this frontend can't render. The same applies to the admin-ui messages_en.properties change.

The admin UI uses i18next interpolation (`{{0}}`), not Java MessageFormat. With `{0}` and `{2,choice,...}`, the placeholders won't be replaced and the raw ChoiceFormat pattern will show in the UI. The community translations of this key still use `{{0}}`, so English is now also out of step with them.

The common-prefix and common-suffix scans are independent, so they can overlap when the shorter string repeats characters at the boundary. Example: value `x` and sanitized `x` gives start=4 and end=3, so `value.substring(4, 1)` throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. That crashes the plugin instead of reporting the problem. Bound the suffix loop so that `end < Math.min(value.length(), sanitized.length()) - start`.

Deriving the English file with string replaceAll on the absolute path is fragile. It rewrites every `resources-community` in the path, including a parent directory with that name. Also, `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` does nothing for a bundle without a locale suffix, so that file gets compared with itself. If no `_en` file exists (for example a custom or community theme with only translations), this throws a RuntimeException that aborts the build. Resolve the sibling file with `file.toPath().resolveSibling(...)` and handle a missing English bundle gracefully (skip, or report through `messages`).

`verify()` declares MojoExecutionException, and read failures there are wrapped in one. Here an unchecked RuntimeException is thrown instead, so Maven reports a plugin crash rather than a proper build error. Throw MojoExecutionException, or let IOException reach the existing catch block. The file is also read twice (`Files.readString` and then `FileInputStream`), so you could reuse `contents` with a StringReader.

This message doesn't include the key or the file, unlike the "Illegal HTML" message. When the build fails across dozens of bundles, there's no way to tell which entry is at fault. Also, after the `break`, the anchors that weren't matched stay in `value`, and the sanitizer then reports the same entry a second time as "Illegal HTML".

`containsHtml` counts `` as HTML. So when the English value contains only an anchor, translations are also allowed `

`, ``, `` and `
`, which the source string never had. The HTML check should look at the English value after its anchors are removed, or better, it should require the translation to use only tags that appear in the English value.

`getAbsolutePath().contains("email")` is true for any path containing that substring, such as a checkout directory or a theme called `email-...`. That turns on the RTL style exemption for login, account and admin bundles as well. Match on the theme type directory (`/email/messages/`) instead.
`POLICY_SOME_HTML`, `POLICY_NO_HTML` and `HTML_TAGS` are named as constants but are mutable instance fields, so they're rebuilt for every file checked. Make them `private static final`.
